cause.label: dilution_or_going_concern
cause.what_happened: WHLR fell about 24% intraday (no gap) on 3.3x volume on 2026-10-05, the Series D Holder Redemption Date. There is no new EDGAR filing dated 10-05. It continues a three-month dilution spiral. Monthly Series D redemptions are settled in new common at the trailing 10-day VWAP. Series B preferred has been exchanged into common (3(a)(9)) on Sep 2, Sep 8 and Sep 23. Two reverse splits followed (8-K Aug 21; 1-for-9 effective Sep 21). The 60-day run-up is -97%.

evidence.claim: The next monthly Holder Redemption Date is October 5, 2026 (request deadline Sep 25). Redemptions are settled in common at the 10-day VWAP before the date. The Sep 8 round issued 348,896 common shares (pre-split) for 8,200 Series D shares, and the notes' conversion price was reset to a 45% discount to the VWAP. The 8-K was filed 2026-09-09 08:45 UTC, before the open.

On Sep 23, 41,061 Series B shares were exchanged for 162,244 common (third-party investor), and Stilwell entities exchanged 58,120 Series B plus 14,530 Series D for 566,670 common. Post-split shares outstanding were about 568k on Sep 21 before these exchanges.
1-for-9 reverse split effective Sep 21 at 5pm ET: 5,113,901 shares became about 568,211. The notes' conversion rate went from 46.43 to 5.16 per $25.
Resale prospectus for 710,466 Series B shares held by Stilwell affiliates. It states that substantial dilution from Series D redemptions and note adjustments is 'anticipated to continue'.

pipeline.next_dated_event: The 8-K on the 2026-10-05 Series D redemption (common shares issued, new note conversion price), expected before the 2026-10-06 open on the 2026-09-09 08:45 UTC precedent. The four prior redemption 8-Ks were filed 1-2 days after the date (Jun 8, Jul 7, Aug 7, Sep 9).
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: An Oct 6 8-K showing few or no Series D redemptions this round, or a notes reset that leaves conversions far out of the money, would remove the dated supply and leave only the base rate.

positioning_check: Nasdaq short interest at the 09/15/2026 settlement was 258,807 shares (down 54.3% from 566,046 at 08/31), 1.0 day to cover. That settlement straddles the Sep 21 1-for-9 split, so the level's split basis is unclear. It lags about 8 business days, so the position carried into today is not observable. No crowded short is evident. There is no option chain, so no skew. Joseph Stilwell (director, 10% owner) holds about 665k common after the Sep 30 exchanges (Form 4 filed 2026-10-02), a large fraction of a share count of roughly 1.3-1.5M. He sold only 5 shares at $3.03. His Form 144 (2026-09-30) covers notes, not common.

findings.finding: Today, 2026-10-05, is the 37th monthly Series D Holder Redemption Date. New common is issued at the 10-day pre-date VWAP and the 7% notes' conversion price resets to a 45% discount. The 8-K disclosing both is expected before the 2026-10-06 open, and holders receiving shares at a reference price above spot can sell inside the window.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Two parts. (1) The redemption shares are issued at today's date and become saleable around Oct 5-6. (2) The redemption 8-K has followed the date by 1-2 days on each of the last four rounds; the Sep round was filed at 04:45 ET the next morning. So both the supply and the disclosure land between today's close and tomorrow's close.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None of the prior redemption-8-K days (Jun 8, Jul 7, Aug 7, Sep 9) appears among the baseline's falls of 16.6% or more. Sep 4 to Sep 8, into the September date, went -7.42%. The name's last five comparable falls were followed by -14.18, +39.04, -18.34, -2.69 and -23.67.
findings.why_not_priced: The date was public, but the size of this round was not. I reconstruct the 10-day closes from the baseline at roughly $2.07-5.3, a reference VWAP of about $3.5-4.5 against a $1.58 spot. Each Series D share (about $42 redemption value) therefore becomes roughly 10 new common shares, which recipients can only sell lower. If the close held this supply, tomorrow's 8-K would be a non-event; it has not printed yet. Mitigant, which is why the size is small: a notes reset of about $1.9-2.5 sits above spot, so note conversions are not immediately in the money, and the redemption count could be small relative to roughly 1M shares traded today.
